# Trainer Studio

> Trainer Studio is an open-source, local-first YOLO image annotation tool. It labels bounding boxes, polygons, oriented boxes, and pose in a browser UI on a FastAPI server that runs on your computer. Datasets stay in Ultralytics YOLO layout (data.yaml, images, labels). The workspace uses dockable panels. Twelve languages ship with the app; English is the default when no language has been saved. License: AGPL-3.0. No account and no telemetry. Repository: https://github.com/ondery/TrainerStudio

Trainer Studio is a YOLO labeling tool and an image annotation tool for object-detection datasets. It is an offline LabelImg alternative when you also need polygons, a class manager, and a VS Code-style workspace. Optional local training can use Ultralytics (YOLO11, YOLOv8, YOLO26 names) or an Apache-2.0 RT-DETR backend. A GPU is not required to label.
